comment: ItemDetail text/value capture for Kiln windows (#120); reuses the measured item-view and tooltip seams. Capture is scoped to the existing ItemDetail hook. The capture's text hook is a mid hook below ui/NativeTextLine's entry (ui/NativeTextLineBody, since 0.2.0-dev.31.13).

ui/NativeTextLineBody.comment: kiln-core's item-detail capture (services/ui_item_detail.cpp) hooks here: ui/NativeTextLine's first instruction after its prologue, xor edx,edx (entry + 0x1c): rbx (and still rdx) the text, rcx the line object. Not the entry: Building Tools (0.34.0) finds ui/NativeTextLine by its first 28 bytes (UiBeginText, which its menu draws with), so Kiln's patch stays below them (docs/kiln/engines/README.md).
